name: Lemony Baked Tofu with Charred Scallion Dressing & Grilled Veggies

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a large baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 lemons
6 medium zucchini squash
3 avocados
3 small bunches green onions (scallions)

instructions.primary_message: Zest lemons into a small bowl. Add salt and pepper, then stir to combine the lemon seasoning; set aside. (Reserve lemons for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and slice zucchini lengthwise into ¼-inch thick planks. Halve and pit avocados. Place both on a platter.
Trim green onions and add to the platter. Drizzle veggies with oil, then season with additional salt and pepper. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Cut the tofu planks in half crosswise. Wipe baking sheet dry with paper towels, then return tofu to the baking sheet. Drizzle tofu with oil and sprinkle with lemon seasoning on both sides. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, flipping halfway through, until tofu is golden and cooked through, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, preheat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or regular skillet over medium-high heat.
Once the pan is hot, working in batches, add the green onions. Grill until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side; return to the platter.
When the onions are done, working in batches, place zucchini on the pan. Grill until tender and charred, 2-3 minutes per side. Return to the platter.
Meanwhile, roughly chop ⅓ of the green onions. Place in the reserved bowl. (Set remainder aside for serving.)

Juice half of the reserved lemons into the bowl with the onions (set remaining lemons aside for the veggies). Add yogurt and spices, then stir to combine. Add water, a few teaspoons at a time, if needed, to reach a drizzling consistency. Set dressing aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp garlic powder

instructions.primary_message: When the zucchini is done, working in batches if necessary, place avocados, cut-side down, on the pan. Grill until charred on the cut-side and warmed through, 1-2 minutes per side; return to the platter.
When the avocados are done, squeeze the reserved lemon over the veggies, then drizzle with additional oil.
To serve, divide tofu and veggies between plates; drizzle dressing over tofu. Enjoy!
